source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: XPCShell and Thunderbird Mochitest tasks list profiling helpers in platform-specific toolchain fetches. The toolchain kind must also reference the named upstream tasks. The checked configuration uses distinct x64 and aarch64 macOS tool sets and architecture-specific Windows node/samply entries. These declarations do not prove that upstream profiling code ran or that a symbolicated artifact was produced.
title: Thunderbird profile tooling is selected in both test fetches and toolchain references
